parsed.rationale_overall: System B provides more thoroughly personalized rationales that explicitly tie recommendations to multiple profile attributes (variable income, debt level, legacy goal, advanced experience) and offers more concrete, actionable instructions with specific tickers, thresholds, and rules. System B also demonstrates stronger diversification analysis (addressing tech concentration, EM overweight, energy correlation benefits) and uses more calibrated language with explicit trade-off discussion, while System A's recommendations are solid but less detailed and contain a couple of mismatched fields (e.g., crypto reduction labeled high risk_level).
